records.completeness_basis: Catalog home on catalog.wichita.edu (2026-2027 Edition) carries the full undergraduate catalog navigation tree listing every program page; counted 94 distinct bachelor's majors, collapsing emphasis/concentration/option/track entries into their major (e.g. BFA in Art studio concentrations, BAA Media Arts concentrations, BME areas, BA/BS Biological Sciences emphases) because our records are keyed per major; each BAED licensure area and each BGS field major counted separately (when unsure, counted); Honors Baccalaureate counted. Excluded minors, certificates, associate, accelerated bachelor's-to-master's entries, honors tracks, departmental honors, the general Real Estate Emphasis and the 'Bachelor of Business Administration' degree overview page. 52 of 94 have verified records.
